text:
Marta G: Speedrun watch party + picnic on the roof Saturday? Think chill spectating of short speedruns (200-400 mins), snacks, and a few quick attempts for folks who want to try. Bring picnic blankets and low chairs.

Keon H: I'm down. I can bring a capture card and my switch for any short runs. Also a tiny battery-powered speaker.

Elsa R: Love this. I can bring a projector and an HDMI extender. Quick ask: can someone bring a small table for the capture laptop?

Tom B: I have a foldable laptop table and a 6-port switch. Also happy to help with OBS scenes if Jonas isn't around.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Start" "4pm" "5pm" "6pm"

partybot: Poll created: "Start" 1 votes: 5pm (3), 4pm (1), 6pm (0).

Marta G: Nice 17: Keon + Elsa + Tom = gear dream team. @Keon can you stream to #random or just record highlights?

Keon H: I can stream low-latency to #random and also save local clips. I'll use 720p @ 30fps to keep uplink sane. If anyone wants to avoid being on-stream, wave before your run.

Elsa R: Table covered. Also bringing an HDMI switch so we can flip between runs without unplugging.

Tom B: OBS tip for capture folks: use the monitor capture + crop plugin for the game area to avoid capturing overlays. If you need, run `obs --profile "speedrun"` to switch profiles.

Marta G: Poll for categories: 1) Short Any% (<30m), 2) Glitchless, 3) Co-op speedrun showcase, 4) Demo/tech runs.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Category" "Short Any%" "Glitchless" "Co-op" "Tech/Demo"

partybot: Poll created: "Category" 1 votes: Short Any% (2), Glitchless (1), Co-op (1), Tech/Demo (0).

Keon H: Networking note: rooftop Wi-Fi sometimes flaps. I'll hotspot my phone as a backup and tether the capture laptop if needed. Bring an extra USB-C cable for tethering.

Elsa R: For anyone trying a run: warm-up controller inputs and label your controller case. Also have a small disinfecting wipe box for pads.

Tom B: I'll set up a simple overlay with run titles + runner name between matches. If people want their splits shown, drop a screenshot of your LiveSplit layout into this thread ahead of time.

Marta G: Snacks: picnic vibes. @Maya can you poll savory vs sweet vs mixed?

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Snacks" "Savory" "Sweet" "Mixed"

partybot: Poll created: "Snacks" 4 votes: Mixed (3), Savory (2), Sweet (1).

Marta G: Great. Logistics: 5pm start, bring blankets, a light jacket, and any chargers. @Keon thanks for streaming + capture. @Elsa thanks for projector. @Tom table + OBS help 10/10.

Keon H: I'll post the stream link ~10 minutes before start. Local recording path: `/home/keon/recordings/speedrun-night` in case anyone wants a copy.

Elsa R: I'll bring a small power strip and gaffer tape for cable runs. Please avoid taping directly to wooden decking if possible.

Tom B: I'll be there early to help with scene switching. Also bring a hat if you plan to sit close to the projector (it's bright).

Maya (events): Event + roof code posted in #events. Reminder: keep noise reasonable after 9pm.

Marta G: Can someone clip a short highlight (20s) for #random after the event? Would love to send a quick montage to folks who can't make it.

Keon H: Yep, I'll cut a 20-30s highlight reel and drop it here. See you Saturday at 5pm! :video_game: :sandwich:
